models.name: todo_todos
models.description: Represents individual to-do items with their title and completion status.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: The to-do item title, required for each item.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: Whether the to-do item has been completed (true) or not (false).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the to-do item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the to-do item was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the to-do item was deleted (soft delete).
